title: Ring of Self Immolation
summary: Spend a Bonus Action to take 1d4 Fire and gain 2 turns of Heat.

fields.Self Immolation: Bonus Action on yourself once per Short Rest. Take 1d4 Fire and gain 2 turns of Heat.
fields.Heat: Take 1d4 Fire at the start of each turn. Heat stacks up to 7. Toggle Heat Convergence to consume the stacks when you next deal Fire damage, adding 1 Fire per remaining turn. A multi-hit spell adds it to the first hit only. An area spell adds it to each target.
fields.Acquisition: Locked wooden chest in the ruined tower north of the Shambling Mound ambush, X 29, Y 63. A nearby skeleton has the key.

changes: Added native BG3 rules using pinned item and linked gameplay sources.
